glosses: present participle and gerund of strike

examples.text: He looked quite striking in his new suit and tie.
This new-comer was a man who in any company would have seemed striking. In complexion fair, and with blue or gray eyes, he was tall as any Viking, as broad in the shoulder.

glosses: On strike, taking part in industrial action.
The act by which something strikes or is struck.

examples.text: We've observed plenty of strikings followed by lightings, so even if we should not say that the strikings cause the lightings, isn't it at least reasonable to predict, and to believe, that the next time we strike a match in similar conditions, it will be followed by a lighting?

glosses: Que es inusual o fuera de lo común.

glosses: Qui fait une impression vive sur les sens, sur l’esprit, sur l’âme.

examples.text: Épictète, l’esclave devenu philosophe, est l’une des figures les plus frappantes de l’Antiquité.
